<!-- pr-reviewer: 802289c0bbe2bab8305749ba4d36218817783366 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review covers the documentation and site test changes for #3403.
I tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3412` with no GitHub runner.
The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`58ecbebb0`) was clean.
The reviewed PR head is `802289c0bbe2bab8305749ba4d36218817783366`.

## What looks good

- All twelve features and settings listed in #3403 have clear text in the existing guide pages.
- Each update names the UI control and tab, explains the behavior, gives a worked example, and states the refusals and fixes.
- I checked the documented controls, defaults, formulas, and refusal strings against the shipped code in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`, `assets/machines/*.mch`, `crates/ui/`, `crates/app/`, `crates/motion/`, `crates/sim/`, and `crates/tools/`. The text matches the implementation.
- Obsolete statements about the Router kind, Deburr depth, and blanket operation warnings are corrected.
- `docs/decisions/3403-guide-v026.md` records the scope and choices.
- `site/tests/test_release_026_guide.py` has a provenance line, stays at 110 lines, and pins all twelve guide items.
- The PR changes no Rust code, no posted G-code, no goldens, no snapshot PNGs, no dependencies, and no process files.
- The PR body has `Changelog: none`, `Fixes #3403`, and a conventional commit subject.

## Local results merged with upstream/main

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `upstream/main` (`58ecbebb0`) | Clean |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed (0 Rust steps, 0 failed; no files under `crates/` changed) |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` | 0 heavy lanes reached |
| `site/tests/test_release_026_guide.py` | 12 passed, 0 failed |
| Full `site/tests` discovery (94 tests) | 88 passed; 6 errors in `test_search_query.py` only because `node` is not installed on this review host (includes 3 passing Zola site build and link tests) |
| Clippy | Not applicable (no Rust crate changed) |

## Extra suites run

No extra suites were required. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no golden file, and no importer code.

## Mutation checks run by this review

1. Restored `site/content/guide/check-and-post/posting.md` to `upstream/main`: `test_release_026_guide.py` failed on `test_fanuc_ai_contour_has_enable_accuracy_and_cancel` and `test_fanuc_manual_guide_blank_has_words_and_limits` (8 failures). Restored the PR file: 12 passed.
2. Restored `site/content/guide/operations/operations-3d.md` to `upstream/main`: `test_release_026_guide.py` failed on `test_3d_adaptive_fallback_is_a_visible_warning` and `test_deburr_documents_chord_depth_passes_and_breaking_change` (4 failures). Restored the PR file: 12 passed.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `site/content/guide/set-up/tools.md` lists **Softwood** and **Hardwood**. The UI dropdown in `crates/tools/src/cutting.rs` shows `Softwood (pine, spruce)` and `Hardwood (oak, maple)`. The short names are clear, so this is not a blocker.
- PR #3306 merged on `upstream/main` after this branch started. It updated the Fanuc Manual Guide i blank help text in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` to note that Series 30i background simulation ignores G20/G21. You can add that one-line note to `site/content/guide/check-and-post/posting.md` at the release cut if you want.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
